name: paperwork-situation
note: Your situation (PW4), the details panel as it opens from the header's "Your situation": the answers the plan is built from, the next question and the Answer history. The same sample record and clock as paperwork.json. The mock's bottom bar ("Continue in Composer", sample note) is left out until Composer can host the questions (session 2, 21 Oct); its "Preview states" demo is mock-only.
